releaseNotes:
- Release Center now shows continuous publishing progress and clear recovery status throughout a release
- Production workflows now use validated, versioned skill bundles for stage completion, project completion, and reliable production synchronization
- The Creator Navigator is now the default workspace: it replaces raw production folders with book progress, a recommended next step, expandable important files, and one-click access to episodes, visuals, audio, preview, and publishing; Project Files remains available as an advanced tool
- Important creator documents now open as visual, beginner-friendly editors that autosave to their real files, while scripts continue to use F Studio and produced media opens directly in Gallery
- Creator documents now use purpose-built semantic workspaces for character bibles, story evaluation, overview, and story graphs, with clearer navigation and structured data editing
- Character portrait review now includes the C6 hair-gap repair path for cleaner fine hair and transparency results
- Lunaverse Script syntax, schemas, compiler behavior, and compatibility rules now come from one versioned authority, with Backend and IDE consumers pinned and checked against its exact revision
- Creator writing progress now uses clearer everyday language, keeps the current activity prominent, and reveals scoped details only when they are useful
- Each book can now choose its preferred image and video generation models, and individual image assets can override the book default when needed
- Gallery now keeps unreferenced media in a collapsed maintenance section, where creators can review or safely clear unused local assets without crowding active production
- The IDE now derives active assets from canonical scripts and automatically coordinates bounded refreshes when project content changes, keeping Agent context and dependent production state current
- Episode writing now uses canonical character demeanor-and-action looks consistently across authoring, validation, previews, and the Villain Season sample
- Novel evaluation now follows the approved evaluator workflow and presents canonical verdicts consistently in creator-facing reports
- Large production Skill Bundles can now be synchronized reliably through validated chunked delivery
releaseNotesZh:
- 发布中心现会在整个发布过程中持续显示进度，并清楚呈现恢复状态
- 生产工作流现使用经过校验且带版本的 Skill Bundle，统一支持阶段完成、项目完成和可靠的生产同步
- 作品导航现已成为默认工作区：它用创作进度、推荐下一步、可展开的重要文件，以及剧集、画面、声音、预览和发布入口取代默认的生产目录树；项目文件仍作为专业工具保留
- 重要创作文档现会以适合新手的可视化编辑器打开并自动写回真实文件；剧本继续使用 F Studio，已生成素材则会直接在画廊中定位
- 创作文档现为人物圣经、故事评估、作品概览和故事图谱提供专用语义工作区，并带来更清晰的导航与结构化数据编辑
- 人物立绘审核现纳入 C6 发丝空隙修复链路，改善细发丝与透明区域的抠图效果
- Lunaverse Script 的语法、Schema、编译器行为和兼容规则现由单一版本化权威统一维护，Backend 与 IDE 会精确锁定并校验对应版本
- 创作进度现使用更直白的日常语言，突出当前正在进行的工作，并只在需要时展开本次任务的详细范围
- 每本书现可分别选择默认的图片与视频生成模型，单个图片素材也可在需要时覆盖全书默认设置
- 画廊现将未引用素材收纳到折叠的维护区域，创作者可查看或安全清理本地闲置素材，同时保持当前生产内容清爽
- IDE 现会从权威剧本推导当前素材，并在工程内容变化时自动协调有限范围的刷新，使 Agent 上下文与依赖的生产状态保持最新
- 剧集写作现会在创作、校验、预览及 Villain Season 示例中统一使用规范化的角色神态与动作造型
- 小说评估现采用已批准的评估流程，并在面向创作者的报告中统一呈现规范化结论
- 大型生产 Skill Bundle 现可通过经过校验的分片传输可靠同步
